faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Female Gym Trainer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application for the PAU Female Gym Trainer recruitment is 18th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Female Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university and a Diploma in fitness training from a recognized institution or sports federation. A certificate in Punjabi language at the Matric level is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Female Gym Trainer position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Female Gym Trainer post is between 18 years and 37 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Female Gym Trainer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Female Gym Trainer position will primarily involve a Practical Test. Candidates will be assessed on their practical skills and knowledge related to gym training and management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Female Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: The selected Female Gym Trainer will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 26,265 to Rs. 27,065, along with an additional Rs. 800 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 177/- for all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. This fee must be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the PAU Female Gym Trainer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Female Gym Trainer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Female Gym Trainer post in this recruitment drive by Punjab Agricultural University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Female Gym Trainer position is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), which is pau.edu. It is advisable to check the website regularly for any updates.
